title: ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2610.21581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying a replacement witness. Its feedback still conveys information about validity: a verified refutation establishes that the claim is false, and rejection reasons can suggest structural fixes. In this evaluation, verifier feedback yields $23/39$ accepted counterexamples on invalid claims and $25/72$ safe completions, compared with $15/39$ and $20/72$ for checker-free generic feedback. translated_title: ClaimScope：面向数学声明审计的标签盲见证验证
translated_abstract: 数学智能体通常通过答案准确率或证明接受度来进行评估。我们提出ClaimScope，一个包含72个任务的基准，用于通过裁决、适用范围、反例和修复来审计所提出的声明。任务涵盖优化器状态传输、有限时域仿射递归以及精确的2×2线性代数。我们使用直接生成和四种匹配的两阶段条件来评估Qwen3-8B，每种条件均从同一份草稿开始。见证检查器仅评估模型提交的状态，既不参考参考裁决，也不提供替代的见证。其反馈仍然传达了关于有效性的信息：经过验证的反驳可以确立该声明为假，而拒绝原因可以提示结构性修复。在此评估中，验证器反馈在无效声明上产生了23/39个被接受的反例和25/72个安全完成，而无检查器的通用反馈仅为15/39和20/72。严格完成（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出ClaimScope，一个基于标签盲见证验证机制的72任务数学声明审计基准，实验表明验证器反馈相比无检查器的通用反馈显著提升了反例接受率（23/39 对 15/39）和安全完成率（25/72 对 20/72）。
en_tdlr: ClaimScope is a 72-task benchmark for auditing mathematical claims through label-blind witness verification, demonstrating that verifier feedback substantially improves accepted counterexamples and safe completions compared to checker-free generic feedback.
